en: The image shows a group of men posing outdoors, many of whom are dressed in traditional Balkan attire, featuring embroidered vests, sashes, and hats that are typical of the region. Some men are in suits, indicating a formal occasion. There are banners with Cyrillic text in the background, and a historic-looking building with ornate architecture can be seen behind the group. The setting is a cobblestone street with trees providing shade.
